categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in the pharmaceutical and chemical industries. The pharmaceutical segment includes pharmaceutical manufacturing (Chinese and Western medicines, biological pharmaceuticals, health foods), pharmaceutical commerce (wholesale and retail), medical services, and drug research and development. The chemical segment focuses on high-dispersion precipitated silica (white carbon black) production for applications in silicone rubber, coatings, and other industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: For pharmaceuticals: the company produces 15 different dosage forms including tablets, capsules, pills, granules, oral liquids, creams, injections, and eye drops. For chemicals: the company has developed core technologies including precipitated silica surface area control, PE separator white carbon black preparation, three-stage pneumatic crushing, surface treatment, iron removal, pH control, pore expansion, thermal utilization, and energy-saving emission reduction techniques. Products meet ISO9001 and SGS standards including EU ROHS directives.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The pharmaceutical segment serves medical institutions, pharmaceutical distributors, and retail pharmacies across China. Major customers include National Pharmaceutical Holdings and one-heart pharmacy chains. The chemical segment serves silicone rubber manufacturers, coating producers, and tire manufacturers. The company has approximately 128 drug production licenses with 55 medical insurance products and 5 nationally exclusive varieties.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters in Meihekou, Jilin Province. Operations span multiple regions including Northeast China (Jilin, Liaoning), East China (Zhejiang), Central China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and North China. The company has subsidiaries in Jiangxi Province and Beijing, with international research operations in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates across multiple supply chain positions: upstream in raw material sourcing (pharmaceutical ingredients, chemical precursors), midstream in manufacturing and processing, and downstream in distribution and retail through its pharmaceutical commerce subsidiaries. The company integrates vertically from production through direct sales and distribution channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on developing innovative pharmaceutical products, particularly in ophthalmology and traditional Chinese medicine. R&D priorities include second-generation development of existing products (improving efficacy and shelf life), new dosage forms, and specialized chemical products. The company emphasizes quality improvement, production efficiency enhancement, and market expansion in OTC products and innovative drugs.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through product sales: pharmaceutical products (58.33% of revenue) sold through direct sales and distribution channels, and chemical products (40.71% of revenue) sold to industrial customers. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of goods, typically upon delivery and receipt verification. The company also generates minor revenue from asset rentals and material sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the pharmaceutical sector, the company competes with major players like National Pharmaceutical Holdings and one-heart pharmacy chains. The company positions itself as a specialized producer of traditional Chinese medicines and ophthalmology products with several nationally exclusive varieties. In chemicals, the company is among the earliest domestic white carbon black producers and holds a leading market position in high-dispersion precipitated silica products.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of December 31, 2024, the company has total assets of 1.44 billion yuan with a severely negative equity position of -776.5 million yuan (resource-constrained situation). 2024 revenue was 333.3 million yuan (down 3.69% from 346.1 million yuan in 2023). The company has experienced continuous losses for six consecutive years with cumulative losses exceeding 3 billion yuan. The company faces critical financial distress with significant debt defaults and liquidity crisis.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes product quality as its core value proposition, offering specialized pharmaceutical products including nationally exclusive varieties and medical insurance-covered products. Key differentiation includes: five nationally exclusive drug varieties or dosage forms, established expertise in traditional Chinese medicine and ophthalmology, advanced manufacturing capabilities across 15 dosage forms, and integrated pharmaceutical commerce operations. The company positions itself as a health-focused enterprise with the core philosophy of 'caring for life and promoting human health.'
